import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/training_3.csv"
]

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(path, index_col=0) for path in source_files]

# According to the operation history, perform UNION of the four source tables
# The target schema is ['attributes'] only, so we select only the 'attributes' column from each source
# The 'attributes' column may contain NaN values; keep them as is to match source data

attributes_dfs = [df[['attributes']] for df in dfs]

# Concatenate (union) all attributes columns vertically
target_df = pd.concat(attributes_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
